research_note: Selected for this session after checking primary source pages. Connections are editorial judgments, not speaker endorsements. Books, papers, and recordings were not reviewed in full; listing checks and access limits are noted below. Additions checked 2026-10-17; earlier entries retain their individual source dates.

resources.title: The Rust Programming Language: Treating Smart Pointers Like Regular References
resources.why: Work through Deref and deref coercion before comparing reference and conversion traits.

resources.title: Rust API Guidelines: Interoperability
resources.why: Apply the conversion and common-trait conventions when reviewing a public API.

resources.title: Borrow trait reference
resources.why: Check the equality, ordering, and hashing obligations that distinguish Borrow from a simple reference conversion.

resources.title: Standard library conversion traits
resources.why: Compare AsRef, From, Into, and fallible conversions alongside Deref and Borrow.

resources.title: Brown's experimental Rust Book
resources.why: Review ownership and borrowing with visual explanations before comparing reference and conversion traits.
resources.caveat: Experimental adaptation of the Rust Book; quiz behavior not tested. Introduction reviewed; the full work and exercises were not reviewed or executed.

resources.title: Rust API Guidelines
resources.why: Use the full API checklist after reading the interoperability chapter already linked for this session.
resources.caveat: Guidance rather than a mandate; a chapter is already linked in this repository.

resources.title: Rust Design Patterns
resources.why: Compare API choices with community explanations of Rust idioms, patterns, and anti-patterns.
resources.caveat: Community guide; individual examples not evaluated. Introduction reviewed; the full work and exercises were not reviewed or executed.

resources.title: Oxide: The Essence of Rust
resources.why: Follow ownership and borrowing explanations into a formal model of a Rust-like language.
resources.caveat: Abstract and publication metadata reviewed; the full paper was not reviewed. This research language is separate from Oxide Computer Company.
